tweets.text: Grok 4.5’s surge inside Augment’s Cosmos isn’t just another model-picker spike. What’s interesting is where the growth is coming from: real engineering teams working on large, messy, production codebases. Augment’s Context Engine already gives models unusually strong repo-wide understanding. When developers start routing more of those hard tasks to Grok 4.5, it signals the model is delivering on the things that actually matter day-to-day: Multi-file reasoning, architectural awareness, and not falling apart once the context gets huge. Most “AI coding” hype still lives in demos and small repos.
